title: Senior citizens meal sponsorship
summary: The project aims to provide meals to senior citizens living in Radhika Old Age Home in Bhayander West. The meals are sponsored by Club Rotarians on certain occasions.
description: The project aims to provide meals to senior citizens living in Radhika Old Age Home in Bhayander West. The meals are sponsored by Club Rotarians on certain occasions. The senior citizens have limited means of survival. The 75 beneficiaries were served meals 3 times, hence total meals served was 225. The meal was served in memory of our Club Rotarian Krishnan's beloved mother Late Smt Sarada Nathan on her death anniversary.
location: Radhika Old Age Home, Mumbai, Maharashtra
